Data sonification

Soundtrack Engine

Hear your data. Anything that changes over time has a shape, and so does every song. We match the shapes, so the music swells exactly where the data does.

Every card is one real event. Line = the raw data, shading = its tension, the curve the music has to follow. Pick a shape and hear it.

← All examples

    Choose a song (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg…) and find the real event that felt like it: a market moment, a storm, a week of wind power, an engine's life, a harvest history or an economy.

    🔒 Your song never leaves your device. It is analysed right here in your browser.

The engine only chooses and aligns existing recordings. It never generates music.
